mapper.sql: r.id, r.tenant_id, r.create_user_id, r.create_time, r.update_user_id, r.update_time, r.deleted_at, r.version, r.resource_id, r.policy_id, r.run_no, r.iteration_no, r."trigger", r.request_id, r.request_sha256, r.state, r.base_version_id, r.sample_count, r.average_score, r.threshold_snapshot, r.window_start, r.window_end, r.model_alias, r.prompt_sha256, r.output_sha256, r.prompt_tokens, r.completion_tokens, r.produced_version_id, r.publication_id, r.auto_published, r.error_code, r.error_message, r.note, r.lease_owner, r.lease_until, r.started_at, r.finished_at

SELECT , bv.version_no AS base_version_no, pv.version_no AS produced_version_no FROM ddc_ai_optimization_run r LEFT JOIN ddc_ai_version bv ON bv.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND bv.resource_id = r.resource_id AND bv.id = r.base_version_id AND bv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN ddc_ai_version pv ON pv.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND pv.resource_id = r.resource_id AND pv.id = r.produced_version_id AND pv.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.request_id = #{requestId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.state IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.state IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED') ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.id FROM ddc_ai_optimization_run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.state = 'PENDING' ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
